name: Shoreline Mafia
notes: The group that made the Ron-Ron sound national, and the research gives it a producer's own sentence to model from: "thundering basslines and laser synths" over a hybrid of "three different sounds of LA beats" — Detroit-influenced trap, contemporary LA, and classic DPG-derived West Coast. That hybrid is why the parameters read as ratchet with the weight moved down: the kick keeps the lane's 1 / and-of-3, but `lockTo808` goes to 0.9 (it is an *808* kick, not a drum), `distortion` is `heavy`, and `slideProb` is 0.55 for the "audible portamento between roots". ⚠ **`hihat.continuous` is false** — the research says hats are "frequently muted for whole verses", which is the one place this lane's kit is allowed to stop. `fillDensity` stays at 0.30 rather than dropping with it, because a model that declares a hat block owes every seed a hat and `drums_hats.rs` refuses anything under ~0.28. ⛔ **`chords.impliedByRiff` is set, and it is a description rather than an exemption.** The research: "one 'laser' synth ... as the only melodic voice, over a static minor chord or `i–VII`; 2-bar loops; harmonic content minimal by design." One chord is the part, so the variety lives where the research puts it — in the riff. `chordDurationBeats` plus `syncopated_cell` and a 36-semitone `voicing.register` are what still give the chord tab something to say; **no progression family beyond the two the research names was added**. ⚠ The 808 register is the researched E1–B1 (28–35) with the ceiling opened to 42, because a P5 or P8 slide inside eight semitones has no target and `bass808.rs` requires one inside the register. ⚠ `arrangement.sectionBars.verse` is **8, not 16** — "members alternate 8-bar blocks rather than 16s" — and `switchUpProb` drops to 0.05 because the research says to "treat the arrangement as first-take and loop-static". `confidence` is `high` on the research's own "high-medium": a direct producer interview plus a large measured tempo/key sample. Fill fingerprint band G. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
